training.schedule: Within each segment: reference_lr * effective_batch/64 * (0.2+0.8*(1+cos(pi*index/length))/2). Prefix is retained, not relabeled a from-scratch 12-epoch schedule.
training.unchanged: Full raw model, EMA, SGD momentum, scaler and all epoch-boundary RNG states resumed; same augmentations, fixed BN statistics, normalization, data and tracker as short plan.

stopping.rule: At joint12 or18, compute each arm best Dev HOTA through current budget minus its best through budget-6. Stop all arms together if all gains <=0.2pp; otherwise extend all arms by6. Always stop at24 and report a cap if the plateau rule is not met.
stopping.selection: Highest Dev HOTA at joint3,6,9,... up to common stopped budget, ties choose earlier; final Test once per selected arm. Test is excluded from scheduling, stopping and checkpoint selection.
